title: 20 Tall Timber Court Vacation Rental
meta_description: 20 Tall Timber Court is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Welcome to 20 Tall Timber Court, a charming retreat perfectly positioned in WaterColor’s Forest District. Overlooking a peaceful green space, this beautifully designed home invites you to relax and reconnect. The open layout, cheerful coastal décor, and thoughtful touches throughout create a bright, welcoming atmosphere. With a private electric cart, four adult bikes, and easy access to Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and the Beach Club, every moment here feels effortless and memorable.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included 4 Adult Bikes Included Parking for 2 Vehicles Positioned Directly in Front of Green Space in the Forest District of WaterColor Secondary Children’s Living Space with Queen Sleeper Sofa Propane Grill 3-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 6-Minute Electric Cart Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 6-Minute Electric Cart Ride to Seaside Experience the Home Located on a quiet street overlooking a peaceful green space, 20 Tall Timber Court offers a welcoming atmosphere and a perfect balance of comfort and convenience. The open-concept main floor includes a bright living area with comfortable seating, a spacious dining area, and a cheerful blue kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances. Whether preparing a casual breakfast or a family dinner, the kitchen is designed for ease and enjoyment. The primary suite on the first floor provides a private retreat with a king bed and an en suite bathroom featuring a soaking tub and walk-in shower. A laundry room and half bathroom are also located on this level for added convenience. Upstairs, guests will find three additional bedrooms and a secondary living space ideal for children or movie nights. The queen bedroom and full bedroom each include private bathrooms with walk-in showers, while the bunk room sleeps four and includes a shared bathroom with a tub/shower combination. The secondary living space includes a queen sleeper sofa, offering additional sleeping flexibility. Two inviting porches extend the home’s living space outdoors. The front porch, overlooking the green space, features Adirondack chairs and a swing for relaxing with morning coffee or evening drinks. The screened porch at the rear offers a quiet spot to unwind, while the propane grill makes outdoor dining simple and enjoyable. With its close proximity to Camp WaterColor, Seaside, and the WaterColor Beach Club, this home is perfectly positioned for exploring 30A and experiencing the best of coastal living.Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub Living Room Kitchen Laundry Room Half Bathroom Second Floor Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Full Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Over Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Secondary Children’s Living Space with Queen Sleeper Sofa Life in WaterColor Positioned in the Forest District, 20 Tall Timber Court offers convenient access to WaterColor’s parks, pools, and scenic pathways. Guests enjoy exclusive access to the WaterColor Beach Club and community pools and are just minutes from Seaside and Camp WaterColor. With comfortable interiors and easy access to 30A attractions, this home provides a relaxed yet refined coastal experience.
